purpose: Grow a project-owned running-script hand from four historically grounded teacher models without averaging or erasing them.

representation.principle: Writer identity and local character realization must be modeled separately; a teacher is not one averaged style vector.

projectHand.mustNotBe: weighted visual average of the four teachers
stableSpine: controlled variation of size, slant, density and spacing

required: no degradation of structural legibility or provenance

evaluation.text: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端
evaluation.projectHandQuestion: Can the fifth plan be recognizably its own hand while every major decision remains explainable through stable grammar and evidence?

researchNotes: Modern handwriting research supports separating writer-level regularities from character-level realization rather than compressing style into one representation.
Structure-aware calligraphy research supports explicit modeling of component relationships so style growth does not destroy character structure.
Historical teacher models must preserve work and period variation; later influences enrich vocabulary but cannot silently rewrite the stable spine.
